# Voice AI API — operations

11 operations. Full request and response shapes: [reference.md](reference.md).

- `voice-ai.create-action` — **Create Agent Action** — `POST /voice-ai/actions` (write, location)
  Create a new action for a voice AI agent.
- `voice-ai.create-agent` — **Create Agent** — `POST /voice-ai/agents` (write, location)
  Create a new voice AI agent configuration and settings
- `voice-ai.delete-action` — **Delete Agent Action** — `DELETE /voice-ai/actions/{actionId}` (write, location)
  Delete an existing action from a voice AI agent.
- `voice-ai.delete-agent` — **Delete Agent** — `DELETE /voice-ai/agents/{agentId}` (write, location)
  Delete a voice AI agent and all its configurations
- `voice-ai.get-action` — **Get Agent Action** — `GET /voice-ai/actions/{actionId}` (read, location)
  Retrieve details of a specific action by its ID.
- `voice-ai.get-agent` — **Get Agent** — `GET /voice-ai/agents/{agentId}` (read, location)
  Retrieve detailed configuration and settings for a specific voice AI agent
- `voice-ai.get-agents` — **List Agents** — `GET /voice-ai/agents` (read, location)
  Retrieve a paginated list of agents for given location.
- `voice-ai.get-call-log` — **Get Call Log** — `GET /voice-ai/dashboard/call-logs/{callId}` (read, location)
  Returns a call log by callId.
- `voice-ai.get-call-logs` — **List Call Logs** — `GET /voice-ai/dashboard/call-logs` (read, location)
  Returns call logs for Voice AI agents scoped to a location.
- `voice-ai.patch-agent` — **Patch Agent** — `PATCH /voice-ai/agents/{agentId}` (write, location)
  Partially update an existing voice AI agent
- `voice-ai.update-action` — **Update Agent Action** — `PUT /voice-ai/actions/{actionId}` (write, location)
  Update an existing action for a voice AI agent.
